text: I shall be able to overcome them: Heb. I shall prevail in fighting against him
Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from: Heb. Be not thou letted from etc.
upon which thou hast ridden: Heb. who hast ridden upon me | ever since I was thine: Or, ever since thou wast, etc.
to withstand thee: Heb. to be an adversary unto thee
displease: Heb. be evil in thine eyes
Kirjathhuzoth: Or, a city of streets
